name: Frederick
description: A sturdy, broad-shouldered man in his late thirties to mid-forties, drawn in 2D flat vector style. Broad forehead with receding light-brown hair swept back, a full thick bushy mustache, calm blue-grey eyes, a steady confident expression. Wears a heavy cream-and-tan fur anorak with a fur-lined hood pushed back, dark fur mittens, and thick sealskin boots. Solid flat color fills, simplified geometric proportions.

name: Young Frederick
description: The SAME man as Frederick but in his mid-twenties, drawn in 2D flat vector style — identical broad forehead and face shape, same light-brown hair (fuller, less receding), a neatly trimmed brown mustache. Youthful, slightly leaner face, earnest determined eyes. Wears a dark charcoal late-1800s wool physician's coat with a high collar over a waistcoat in the early scenes, or a plain brown wool expedition coat. Solid flat color fills.

name: Frederick Gaunt
description: The SAME man as Frederick after a fourteen-month Arctic ordeal — emaciated and skeletal, drawn in 2D flat vector style. Same broad forehead and face structure but with deep sunken cheeks, hollow shadowed eyes, and a long ragged overgrown brown beard replacing the neat mustache. Frostbitten, weather-darkened skin. Wears a filthy tattered and frost-crusted fur anorak hanging loose on his thin frame. Solid flat color fills, gaunt simplified proportions.

name: Robert
description: A tall, lean, imposing man in his late thirties to fifties, drawn in 2D flat vector style. Very large distinctive reddish-brown walrus mustache dominating his face, receding auburn-red hair, piercing pale steel-blue eyes, a strong square jaw and stern determined expression. Wears a heavy grey-brown fur parka with a large fur hood ruff, fur mittens, and sealskin boots. Solid flat color fills, simplified geometric proportions.

name: Young Robert
description: The SAME man as Robert but in his twenties, drawn in 2D flat vector style — same strong square jaw and face shape, same auburn-red hair (fuller, less receding), a large reddish-brown mustache slightly smaller than in later years. Youthful confident face. Wears a dark navy-blue 1880s naval civil-engineer uniform jacket with brass buttons and a high collar, or a dark formal frock coat. Solid flat color fills.

name: Matthew
description: A strong, capable Black American man aged roughly twenty to early forties, drawn in 2D flat vector style. Warm dark brown skin, close-cropped black hair, a neat black mustache and short beard, alert intelligent eyes, a calm resolute expression. Wears a dark brown fur anorak with a fur-lined hood, fur mittens, and sealskin boots. Solid flat color fills, simplified geometric proportions.

name: Young Matthew
description: The SAME person as Matthew but as a thirteen-year-old cabin boy, drawn in 2D flat vector style — same warm dark brown skin and face shape, younger and rounder, short cropped black hair, no facial hair, bright curious eyes. Wears simple 1870s merchant-sailor clothes: a rough grey wool jacket, a dark knit cap, and worn trousers. Solid flat color fills.

name: Harry
description: A well-groomed wealthy American sportsman in his thirties, drawn in 2D flat vector style. Clean-cut handsome face, neatly combed dark hair, a trim mustache, an easygoing refined expression. Wears an expensive fur-trimmed hunting parka in rich green-brown tones, tailored and clean compared to the weathered explorers, with leather gloves. Solid flat color fills, simplified geometric proportions.

name: The Financier
description: A distinguished wealthy gentleman in his sixties, drawn in 2D flat vector style. Silver-white hair and thick white side-whiskers (muttonchops), a broad clean-shaven chin, shrewd kindly eyes. Wears a formal black 1890s frock coat with a waistcoat, a high white collar, and a dark cravat. Portly, dignified bearing. Solid flat color fills.

name: The Blacksmith
description: A rugged working-class man in his forties, drawn in 2D flat vector style. Broad muscular build, a thick unkempt dark-brown beard, weathered ruddy face, wary shifting eyes. Wears plain rough grey-brown wool work clothes, a leather apron, a flat cloth cap, and heavy boots. Solid flat color fills, simplified geometric proportions.

name: The Older Hunter
description: An experienced older Inuit hunter, drawn in 2D flat vector style. Weathered broad face with high cheekbones, warm brown skin, dark eyes with squint lines, black hair under his hood. Wears traditional thick caribou-skin fur clothing: a fur anorak with a rounded hood, fur trousers, and sealskin boots, all in warm brown and cream tones. Calm, capable expression. Solid flat color fills.

name: The Younger Hunter
description: A younger Inuit hunter in his twenties, drawn in 2D flat vector style. Smooth broad face with high cheekbones, warm brown skin, dark eyes, black hair under his hood. Wears traditional caribou-skin fur clothing similar to The Older Hunter — a fur anorak with a rounded hood, fur trousers, sealskin boots — but in slightly darker grey-brown tones to tell them apart. Alert, energetic expression. Solid flat color fills.
